name: AI router (sub-workflow): picks model per task, handles fallback

nodes.name: Called by a workflow
nodes.notes: Input: userId, task (sort / draft / tier3), schema (classification / draft), messages (system and user, client text quoted as data), and optionally template (the fixed answer to use if no model gives a valid one).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ userId: $json.userId, task: $json.task, schema: $json.schema, messages: $json.messages, template: $json.template }) }}

nodes.name: Route in the app
nodes.notes: The app picks the model (local first, then the cloud fallback if the user added one, then the template), decrypts the user's key, checks the answer against the schema and retries once. Returns { ok, via, output, attempts }. Local dev URL; change it for a deployed app.
